title: Three Christmases and One Short Ribbon
subtitle: 人际交往 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际交往（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·良好的人际关系与人际交往）
meta: 主题语境：人际交往（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·良好的人际关系与人际交往）　|　核心词汇：gift　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gift 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 my aunt ① gave a gift that no cousin in the house would have described, and she said the giving was the whole of the Christmas. The ② gift, meaning the parcel itself and not the card, ran three Christmases and stayed undescribed in the book; a gift, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ gift in that house had the same short ribbon beside it, and the ④ gift at the far table, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A gift, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; my aunt said the describing is the part that fills three Christmases.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the gift was the whole of the matter, meaning the talent and not the parcel. The ⑥ gift, meaning the talent and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; gift, he said, is either something you give or the only word that means both a parcel and a talent. He said the talent is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ gift had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short ribbon. The ⑧ gift of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in November, was one house and three Christmases of describing; gift, she said, is either the one at the far table or the reason you learned to describe. She said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ gift I remember is the one described in the list, which closed in 1980 and is still described as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ gift, my mother said in 1981, is the only one that improves by being described; every gift, she said, is a talent that has agreed to look like a parcel. She said the talent was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 礼物（指那座房子里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 礼物（指那个包裹本身，与贺卡相对）
C. 固定搭配：give a gift 送一份礼物
D. n. 礼物（指留给孩子们的那一份）
E. n. 馈赠（抽象总称，指一座房子的送礼之事）
F. n. 礼物（指清单里写到、被记下的那一份）
G. n. 天赋；才能（a gift for music，指一件事里人人都夸却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 天分（抽象总称，指人人都夸却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: gave a gift that no cousin in the house would have described
The gift, meaning the parcel itself and not the card
the gift at the far table
the gift was the whole of the matter
the gift had become a line in a list
The gift of the whole thing
A gift, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: give a gift 意为“送一份礼物”，1973 年姑姑送了一份那座房子里没有一位表亲肯描述的礼物。
gift 意为“礼物”，指那个包裹本身而不是贺卡，它经过了三个圣诞节而在簿子上没有被描述。
gift 意为“礼物”，指那座房子里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一条矮矮的缎带。
gift 意为“礼物”，指最远那张桌上留给孩子们的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
gift 意为“天赋、才能”，指一件事里人人都夸却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份天赋就是那件事的全部。
gift 意为“天分”，指人人都夸却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份礼物，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
gift 意为“礼物”，指清单里写到、被记下的那一份，到 1978 年这一份成了清单里的一行。
gift 意为“馈赠”，姑姑十一月写道，整件事的送礼之事是一座房子和三个圣诞节的描述。
gift 意为“礼物”，我记得的是清单里描述过的那一份，1980 年送出去了，至今仍被说成房子里最安静的一份。
gift 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，一份礼物是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
